game.name: Hill Climb Racing 2
game.rules:
Replays aren’t allowed except for the adventure distance category.

September 5th, 2024: Montages aren't allowed for a specific level, only the level footage may be shown.

March 2nd, 2025: CHALLENGES ARE NOT ALLOWED

categories.name: All Season Cups
categories.rules:
-Video is required for WR
-You must cross the finish line on every track in each cup.
-The time starts when you tap/click to confirm you are ready before the countdown of the first track. 
-The time ends when you cross the finish line of the last track.

categories.name: Adventure
categories.rules: Make it as far as you can with whatever vehicle.

categories.name: Cups
categories.rules: Finish the shown number amount of cups as fast as you can!

categories.name: Level Leaderboard (RULES) - View Rules To See
categories.rules: When doing individual levels make sure your using a 3 digit timer and that the timer is on screen then we mods don’t have to make sure the time is right. (Thanks, RealOttawaTodd.)

categories.name: Most Km In A Week
categories.rules: Take a screenshot of the most Kilometres in a week that you have achieved, highest Km in the week wins.

categories.name: Most Km In A Week
categories.rules: Take a screenshot of the most Kilometres in a week that you have achieved, highest Km in the week wins.

categories.name: Time Trial
categories.rules: Video is required; you may record yourself racing against your PB ghost. Ensure the final time of your run is visible in the video.

categories.name: All Cups
categories.rules:
-Video is required for WR
-You must cross the finish line on every track in each cup.
-The time starts when the pedal is pressed. 
-The time ends when you cross the finish line of the last track.

categories.name: Adventure
categories.rules:
Drive as far as you can goal is to make it as far as you can on the selected map.

RULES:

- Time starts when you press the pedal.

categories.name: Adventure Distance
categories.rules:
Drive as far as you can!
You can show replay in x4 speed

- When submitting your time make sure that you make your time how much distance you got in game for example.
EXAMPLE:-Distance you got was 1000m
In the min tab (When submitting) make it 10 then make the secs tab the 00 so it will show the distance as 1000m. The max distance you can go is 60,999m. Thanks. It will just be more clear for players.

categories.name: Trophie Road
categories.rules:
Try to get many cups as fast as it's possible

If You want to speedrun this category, You need to have Challenger Rank (At least Chellanger 1). If speedruning 1000 or 5000 cups, Then boss fights aren't allowed. If speedruning 10000, 25000 or 50000 cups, then boss fights are allowed. You Can't start with Win Streak (Even if you won 1 time). collecting Tasks aren't allowed (because it gives extra 100 cups per task).
